title.narrative: Strengthening shock-responsive systems in Karamoja (Addendum to Contract FOOD/2020/416-880).

description.narrative: The Programme, Strengthening Shock-responsive Systems in Karamoja, is a joint collaboration between WFP, FAO and the Department of Relief, Disaster Preparedness and Management (DRDPM) of the Office of the Prime Minister, funded by the European Union (EU). The Programmes objective is to strengthen the Government of Ugandas capacity to reduce, anticipate and rapidly respond to the effects of shocks and sustain climate-resilient rural development.
